inputs.question: Are the retaining walls with guardrails located within the right-of-way, public easements, or City property? Or are they on private property within the development site?
inputs.regionHint: Look at the retaining walls along the northern boundary and check their relationship to ROW lines, easements, and property lines
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking about the spatial relationship between retaining walls and property/easement boundaries—specifically whether they fall within ROW/easements or on private property. This requires visual inspection of how the walls are positioned relative to boundary lines and easement annotations on the plan, not a numeric measurement or document presence check.

result.answerText: No, the retaining walls with guardrails are not located within the right-of-way or public easements. They are situated on private property within the development site, inside the property line and adjacent to the public sidewalk easements.
